package runtimepersistence

import (
	"context"
	"database/sql"
	"fmt"
	"testing"

	"github.com/division-sh/swarm/internal/runtime/destructivereset"
	"github.com/division-sh/swarm/internal/store/testutil/agentfixture"
	"github.com/division-sh/swarm/internal/testutil"
)

func TestGDiagnosticAfterAdmittedResetProbe(t *testing.T) {
	for _, sqlite := range []bool{true, false} {
		for _, projected := range []bool{true, false} {
			t.Run(fmt.Sprintf("sqlite=%t/projected=%t", sqlite, projected), func(t *testing.T) {
				var selected diagnosticProjectionTestStore
				var db *sql.DB
				if sqlite {
					s := newBootstrappedSQLiteRuntimeStoreForTest(t)
					selected, db = s, s.backend.ConstructionHandle()
				} else {
					_, db, _ = testutil.StartPostgres(t)
					selected = admitTestPostgresStore(t, db)
				}
				ctx := testAuthorActivityContext()
				item := enqueueDiagnosticTestAgent(t, selected, "retained-diagnostic")
				if projected {
					if _, err := selected.ProjectAgentLifecycleDiagnostics(ctx, 100); err != nil {
						t.Fatal(err)
					}
				}
				capability, err := agentfixture.ProcessCapability(t, ctx, selected)
				if err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				request := admitRetainedResetCleanupProof(t, capability, selected.(destructivereset.QuiescenceStore), item.Identity.RunID, false)
				if _, err := capability.ApplyDestructiveResetCleanup(ctx, request, nil); err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				var runs, outbox int
				if err := db.QueryRow("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM runs WHERE run_id=$1", item.Identity.RunID).Scan(&runs); err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				if err := db.QueryRow("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM agent_lifecycle_diagnostic_outbox WHERE outbox_id=$1", item.OutboxID).Scan(&outbox); err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				if runs != 0 || outbox != 1 {
					t.Fatalf("cleanup prerequisite runs=%d outbox=%d", runs, outbox)
				}
				if n, err := selected.ProjectAgentLifecycleDiagnostics(context.Background(), 100); err != nil {
					t.Fatalf("admitted reset poisoned later projection: projected_before=%t projected_now=%d retained=%d run=%d err=%v", projected, n, outbox, runs, err)
				}
			})
		}
	}
}
